# Tone Generator - Online Acoustics & Audio Frequency Tool
> https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/tonegenerator/

## Overview
Tone Generator is a web application designed for audio engineers, sound designers, musicians, and acousticians. It leverages the client-side HTML5 Web Audio API to produce real-time, zero-latency, mathematically accurate sound frequencies ranging from 1 Hz up to 20,000 Hz.

## Technical Specifications
- Engine: Web Audio API (AudioContext, OscillatorNode, GainNode).
- Latency: Hardware native (~0ms buffer latency, client-side synthesis).
- Waveforms:
  - Sine: Pure harmonic spectrum ($f_0$ fundamental only).
  - Square: Odd mathematical harmonics ($f_0, 3f_0, 5f_0 \dots$) with $1/n$ amplitude roll-off.
  - Triangle: Odd mathematical harmonics with $1/n^2$ amplitude roll-off.
  - Sawtooth: Continuous complete harmonic spectrum (all integer multiples $n \cdot f_0$).
- Frequency Bounds: 1 Hz to 20,100 Hz.
- Master Volume: Anti-click parameterized gain ramping via setTargetAtTime.

## Key Formulas
- Speed of Sound: $v \approx 343 \text{ m/s}$ at $20^\circ\text{C}$ in atmospheric air.
- Acoustic Wavelength: $\lambda = \frac{v}{f}$
- Musical Pitch (MIDI conversion):
  $n = 69 + 12 \log_2\left(\frac{f}{440}\right)$
- Cents deviation:
  $\text{cents} = (n - \text{round}(n)) \times 100$

## Acoustic Bands
- Sub-Bass: 20 Hz to 60 Hz
- Bass: 60 Hz to 250 Hz
- Low Midrange: 250 Hz to 500 Hz
- Midrange: 500 Hz to 2,000 Hz
- Upper Midrange / Presence: 2,000 Hz to 6,000 Hz
- Brilliance / High Treble: 6,000 Hz to 20,000 Hz

## Usage Guidelines & Safety
Continuous exposure to high-amplitude high frequencies (>8 kHz) or sub-audible high-excursion frequencies (<30 Hz) can damage listening gear or induce auditory fatigue. Always calibrate levels beginning below 25% master gain.
